data.gender_notes: Promise is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, a promise is a solemn declaration, an agreement between God and man. It is a guarantee of His love, faithfulness, and protection. The name Promise carries the meaning “A pledge or a guarantee” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Promise usually hope their child will grow to embody a pledge or a guarantee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope and faith, representing God's unwavering commitment to His promises.
data.etymology: Promise belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “A pledge or a guarantee.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Promise total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
